flowContents.name: Lab 6 - NDJSON pipeline
flowContents.comments: Lab 6. Part 1: Writer schema (UpdateRecord + log.schema.out) -> #{out.dir}. Part 2: JoltTransformRecord -> #{out.dir}/jolt. Shared services in this group.

processGroups.name: Part 1 - Writer schema
processGroups.comments: ValidateRecord -> UpdateRecord (ingest_ts) -> MergeRecord -> PutFile; field order and pwd removal come from the Writer schema log.schema.out

processors.name: GenerateFlowFile
processors.comments: 3 lines: 2 valid, the third without svc/msg -> invalid

processors.name: UpdateRecord
processors.comments: Field order and pwd removal are defined by the Writer schema (log.schema.out)

processors.name: MergeRecord
processors.comments: Without Max Bin Age the bin waits for 1000 records

processGroups.name: Part 2 - Jolt
processGroups.comments: Same pipeline with JoltTransformRecord instead of UpdateRecord + Writer schema; output: #{out.dir}/jolt

processors.name: ValidateRecord
processors.comments: Jolt does not validate: keep ValidateRecord in front

processors.name: JoltTransformRecord
processors.comments: remove user.pwd; shift: ingest_ts first (from the ingest.ts attribute), all other fields as is

processors.name: MergeRecord
processors.comments: Infer Schema + w-raw: the output shape comes only from Jolt

parameters.name: log.schema.out
parameters.description: LogEvent schema (section 2.2.4): ingest_ts first, no user.pwd
